note: Measurement techniques of the explorer's instrument search (SPEC-TECH-001). An explorer-side layer, not part of the Zenodo release. Aliases are matched after removing case and every character that is not a letter or digit. An alias must name one technique only; words that span techniques (microscope, spectrometer, plate reader) are left out on purpose.

techniques.label: IR spectroscopy
techniques.definition: Infrared absorption spectroscopy (FT-IR, ATR-IR), in-line or off-line; not infrared heating, temperature or proximity sensing.

techniques.label: UV-Vis spectroscopy
techniques.definition: Ultraviolet-visible (and near-infrared) absorption or transmission measurement by a spectrometer, spectrophotometer or absorbance plate reader; not a detector built into a chromatograph.

techniques.label: Raman spectroscopy
techniques.definition: Raman scattering spectroscopy, including Raman probes and Raman microscopes.

techniques.label: Fluorescence / photoluminescence
techniques.definition: Emission spectroscopy or intensity measurement (fluorescence, photoluminescence, luminescence), by a spectrometer or a plate reader in emission mode.

techniques.label: Dynamic light scattering
techniques.definition: Particle sizing by dynamic light scattering (DLS), including flow-through and plate DLS.

techniques.label: NMR spectroscopy
techniques.definition: Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, benchtop or high field, in-line or with an autosampler.

techniques.label: Mass spectrometry
techniques.definition: Mass spectrometry (ESI, APCI, MALDI, quadrupole and others), alone or coupled to a chromatograph.

techniques.label: Liquid chromatography (HPLC/UPLC)
techniques.definition: Analytical liquid chromatography (HPLC, UPLC, UHPLC) with its detectors (UV, DAD, PDA, ELSD); size-exclusion chromatography has its own entry.

techniques.label: Gas chromatography
techniques.definition: Gas chromatography (GC, GLC, headspace GC) with its detectors (FID, TCD).

techniques.label: Size-exclusion chromatography (GPC/SEC)
techniques.definition: Size-exclusion or gel permeation chromatography for molar-mass distributions.

techniques.label: X-ray diffraction
techniques.definition: X-ray diffraction (powder, thin film, synchrotron wide-angle diffraction).

techniques.label: X-ray scattering
techniques.definition: Small- and wide-angle or total X-ray scattering (SAXS, WAXS, PDF).

techniques.label: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy
techniques.definition: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).

techniques.label: X-ray fluorescence
techniques.definition: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) for elemental composition, including XRF microscopes.

techniques.label: Electron diffraction
techniques.definition: Electron diffraction of surfaces (RHEED, LEED).

techniques.label: Electron microscopy
techniques.definition: Scanning or transmission electron microscopy (SEM, TEM, STEM).

techniques.label: Optical microscopy and camera imaging
techniques.definition: Optical microscopes and cameras used to image samples (machine vision, colour, phase or droplet imaging, hyperspectral imaging).

techniques.label: Electrochemical measurement
techniques.definition: Potentiostatic or galvanostatic measurement (voltammetry, impedance, battery cycling, conductivity cells).

techniques.label: Weighing
techniques.definition: Mass measurement by a balance or scale.

techniques.label: pH measurement
techniques.definition: pH measurement by an electrode or meter.

techniques.label: Film thickness and profilometry
techniques.definition: Film thickness or surface profile measurement (reflectometry, ellipsometry, profilometry).
